summary.text: Luther H. Cifers III is a Republican member of the Virginia Senate, representing District 10, which covers all of Amelia County, Appomattox County, Buckingham County, Cumberland County, Fluvanna County, Goochland County and Powhatan County, and parts of Hanover County, Louisa County and Prince Edward County, and has served in the Senate since 2025.
Cifers sits on the Senate committees on Local Government; Privileges and Elections; and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Luther H. Cifers III was born in Richmond, Virginia on June 5, 1974, according to the Senate profile.
The profile lists Cifers's education as Southside Virginia Community College (AA General Studies).
The profile gives Cifers's occupation as entrepreneur.
